description: The bar chart illustrates task counts across language-family categories, with three outcomes indicated by which model is “better” (mBERT, XLM-R, or same). The horizontal axis contains the categories IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “task count” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks at 0, 10, 20, and 40 (and intermediate gridlines). For each category there are three adjacent bars: a light blue bar for mBERT, a darker blue bar for XLM-R, and a light green bar for same, as indicated by the legend in the upper right. Approximate bar heights by category are: IE-Baltic (mBERT 0, XLM-R ~10, same ~7), IE-Germanic (mBERT ~4, XLM-R ~18, same ~22), IE-Indic (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~5, same ~4), IE-Romance (mBERT ~4, XLM-R ~13, same ~30), IE-Slavic (mBERT ~12, XLM-R ~39, same ~28), IE-other (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~6, same ~8), Isolate (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~5, same ~1), Semitic (mBERT 0, XLM-R ~7, same ~1), and Uralic (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~14, same ~5). The bars are grouped by category (not stacked), appear unsorted beyond the displayed category order, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with annotations or special outlines beyond their color coding.
